Gross profit margin fell to 25% from 30% a year ago
CEO Vincent Gladu to step down by April 2027, succession search underway
Company plans to expand pure silver jewelry into a broader collection over time
Menē says planning for 2027 is underway, with brand refresh efforts now a key focus
Company expects to announce further product launches in Q4 and beyond
ORDER DECLINE OFFSET - Co said higher average order value offset an 18% decline in orders and a 13% drop in new customer acquisitions
CUSTOMER ACQUISITION TREND - Co said the rate of decline in new customer acquisitions improved month-over-month due to recent tactics
